contract: GET /auth/openid/mobile-redirect candidate recorded from server/Auth.js:380. Method, path, query/body variants, auth/permission gates, payload shape/types, errors and side effects must match upstream v2.37.2.
exceptions: The force scenario is not applicable because GET /auth/openid/mobile-redirect has no force or refresh operation.
Other redirect schemes, missing-code behavior, and additional middleware/query variants remain unverified.

invariants.contract: For an allowlisted mobile redirect URI, OIDC authorization requires an S256 PKCE challenge, forwards state/challenge, redirects the provider callback to /auth/openid/mobile-redirect, and matches Express redirect status, Location, content type, content length, and body; the callback redirects to the app with encoded code/state, then consumes that state.
exceptions: Evidence covers one allowlisted audiobookshelf://oauth URI and S256 flow only.

invariants.contract: Repeating the mobile redirect callback with consumed state returns HTTP 400, text/html; charset=utf-8, exact Express Content-Length and weak ETag, and the State parameter mismatch body.
An unlisted mobile redirect URI, absent PKCE challenge, or non-S256 challenge method returns the upstream HTTP 400 text response including Express content type, length, and ETag.
The allowlisted mobile redirect state expires after ten minutes and returns HTTP 400 with the upstream HTML content type, exact Content-Length, weak ETag, and State parameter mismatch body.
exceptions: One allowlisted URI with one S256 flow after 10 minutes is covered; other redirect schemes and exact expiration boundary remain unverified.
